name: fix-table-merge-picker
title: Fix table merge picker opening
description: Wire the existing searchable table picker directly to the React table action button so managers can select same-floor tables reliably.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The observer-based fallback did not reliably enhance the rendered portal. The corrected fix reuses the existing picker but invokes it from the owning React component; schema, resolver, permissions, audit logging, and mutation contracts remain unchanged.
